sections.heading: Overview
bullets: A shrinking-arena fight with a hard-fail breakbar attack — no enrage listed, but a missed breakbar can wipe the squad outright.

sections.heading: Howling Death (breakbar)
bullets: If the defiance bar isn't broken within 6.75 seconds of this attack, the target flees in terror and it's a squad wipe. This is the one mechanic that must never be missed.

sections.heading: Shrinking platform
bullets: The arena shrinks at 90%, 66%, and 33% health — anyone standing near the edge when it shrinks falls and dies. Move toward the center as those thresholds approach.

sections.heading: Adds & attacks
bullets: Tormented Dead spawn at the center after the first wall (past 90%) — killing them leaves Volatile Souls that drop damaging Soul Rift puddles, so don't kill them in a stack.
Two players get fixated via Issue Challenge — know who's holding it.
Watch for Surging Souls (moving death lines), Spinning Scythes (boon corrupt), and Slice (a frontal cone that spawns skeletal fingers).
